chunks: Regarding a man who has arrows without iron tips, and they are all wooden sticks: if he shoots with the wooden shaft and strikes the middle of the bird broadside and kills it, and he mentions the Name of Allah over it, then even if blood does not come out, and it is a known arrow, he may eat from it if he mentioned the Name of Allah, the Mighty and Majestic.

key_terms.اسْمَ اللَّهِ: the Name of Allah pronounced at the time of hunting
key_terms.حَدِيدٌ: iron tip or metal head of the arrow
key_terms.دَمٌ: blood flowing from the hunted animal
key_terms.نِبَالَةٌ مَعْلُومَةٌ: a recognized or known type of hunting arrow

ai.seo_question: Is a bird lawful to eat if it is hunted with a wooden arrow without an iron tip and no blood comes out?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about hunting with a wooden arrow that has no iron tip. If the bird is killed by such a recognized hunting projectile and the hunter mentions the Name of Allah, it is permissible to eat from it even if blood does not flow.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4137 - Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) said

regarding a man who has arrows without iron tips, and they are entirely wooden. If he shoots with the wooden arrow and strikes the bird in the middle while it is flying and kills it, and he mentions the name of Allah (swt) upon it, even if no blood comes out, and these are known arrows, then he may eat from it if he has mentioned the name of Allah (swt), the Mighty and Majestic.
